senses.definition: A large box with a flat lid.
(Abrahamism) The ship built by Noah to save his family and a collection of animals from the deluge; Noah's ark.

quotes.text: In the midrash about Noah it says that Noah had a stone which, when held up in the darkness of the ark, would change color when the sun was shining outside.
